stories.title: Microsoft shipped a native Xbox 360 emulator with its new backwards-compatible releases on PC — modders quickly got 360 games running with minor tweaks

sources.title: Microsoft shipped a native Xbox 360 emulator with its new backwards-compatible releases on PC — modders quickly got 360 games running with minor tweaks
sources.title_en: Microsoft shipped a native Xbox 360 emulator with its new backwards-compatible releases on PC — modders quickly got 360 games running with minor tweaks
sources.title_original: Microsoft shipped a native Xbox 360 emulator with its new backwards-compatible releases on PC — modders quickly got 360 games running with minor tweaks
sources.summary: Microsoft dropped four OG Xbox titles on PC a couple of days ago and they came with a native Xbox 360 emulator baked in. These games are packaged as Xbox 360 files, to the emulator runs them as such, then another emulator takes over to translate OG Xbox code inside the virtualized 360 environment.
sources.summary_zh: 几天前，微软在 PC 上发布了四款 OG Xbox 游戏，它们附带了原生 Xbox 360 模拟器。这些游戏被打包为 Xbox 360 文件，模拟器按原样运行它们，然后另一个模拟器接管在虚拟 360 环境中翻译 OG Xbox 代码。

sources.summary: Mini PC specialist Geekom has updated its A9 Max design with AMD’s latest mobile silicon. The incremental improvements of the AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX470 are supported by a revamped Ice Blast 3.0 cooling solution with larger fan and all copper heatpipes in a sleek 0.9L chassis.
sources.summary_zh: 迷你 PC 专家 Geekom 使用 AMD 最新的移动芯片更新了 A9 Max 设计。 AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX470 的逐步改进得到了改进的 Ice Blast 3.0 冷却解决方案的支持，该解决方案在时尚的 0.9L 机箱中配备了更大的风扇和全铜热管。
